I’m the artist and author behind Painting Dragon Feathers, JD Donnelly, and I sell: 
-Original hand-cast and painted figures and mythological/fossil replicas.
-Original pieces of art--marker, pencil, watercolor, ink, etc. 
-Block printed crafts--coasters, stamps, patches, printed hand bound books and journals, etc.
-Archival-grade prints of original art pieces (paintings, scratchboards, etc.) 
-Hand-crafted terrariums featuring Poke'mon, dinosaurs, dragons, faux fossils, and original cast and 
painted figures/creatures with a selection of semi-precious stones, resin, and light effects.
-Hand-pulled, hand-carved block prints, small to limited edition. 
- Select publications, including original novels such as CryptoZoo, contributing zines, and collaborative 
tarot decks.
Thank you for your time and consideration.
